我的生活与购物(My Life and shopping): 一篇关于购物消费的A2短文:汤姆与利奥的经历和小计划。
There are always many people at the online shop. The discount area is one of the best places in the city. The weather was cloudy that day. The vase was damaged in transit.
Leo is interested in swimming. Last Friday, Tom and Leo went to the discount area. Tom usually has rice for breakfast. Best of all, the children swam safely in the shallow end of the pool.
Tom and Leo had great fun there. It takes twenty minutes to get to the discount area by bike. Tom plays basketball with Leo every Friday. Bargain hunters arrive at opening time.
Life is full of small surprises. Both of them like rice and tea. Leo's birthday is in October.
